provenance.note: This repository is code-only. These numbers come from the internal E5 re-freeze, the source of truth reconciled by the papers; the reconstructed panels that produced them carry licensed S&P Compustat fields and are not shipped, so this manifest cannot be regenerated from this repository alone. Obtain the panels on motivated request (see the README), place them under data/, and run the pipeline to reproduce.
provenance.seeds_note: All randomness is seeded in AnalysisSettings (monte_carlo_seed / bootstrap.random_seed / injection.random_seed / robustness_benchmark.random_seed), so the run is deterministic.
provenance.m6_note: The family3 counterfactual RED verdict targets only the four primary composites (eq. 13); softmax/orthogonal variants were removed from the family3 flag (M6). This changes only the family3 status labeling and the global-GREEN transition rate; phase-7 FDR (T_IUT 319 / Z+ 206 / Z2Mah 204) and the flag rate (5.3%) are unaffected.
